Nutrition Information: ( as calculated on myfitnesspal ) 
C: 41  F: 5 | P: 12
Calories: 213 per serve
Makes 5 medium sized 

Ingredients
1 cup masoor dal ( 190 grams ) 
1 tsp haldi 
1 tsp salt
1 cup water ( enough water to cover the dal just barely, you dont want too much ) 

1 tbsp oil 
3 dry red chilli 
8 garlic cloves 
1 onion, thinly sliced
large handful chopped coriander 

to serve, 1 tsp ghee 

Method 
rinse and soak dal for 45 minutes 
Cook with 1 cup water till water is absorbed and dal is fully cooked , leave to cool 

In a pan add oil and fry the chilli and garlic 
Take them off heat cool down and mash them up
You can either cook onions or use raw Thats upto you :) 

Combine everything together and form into balls and enjoy :) 

Best served with rice and some ghee :)
